mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes economic contraction and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 580 and INDPRO < 97.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 210, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 550.0 thousand units signals weak residential demand, which typically precedes a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 550.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicate stagflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy uncertainty and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 210 and UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During an industrial slowdown (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing output contraction typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
